Change log:
1.4.0 (2026-06-01)
  • Signals: Added productType field to Signal response of GET /applicants/{partnerApplicantId}/signals. Values: MCA, TERM_LOAN, LOC.
1.3.0
  • Webhooks: Added new event for completed batch estimations.
  • Applicants: Added endpoint to list pre-offer estimations for applicants.
  • Applicant Onboarding: Added asynchronous enrichment of applicant details after redirect journey to pre-fill onboarding data.
1.2.0
  • Partners can now batch submit pre-offer estimations requests to pre-load Signals before applicants reach the UI.
1.1.0
  • New endpoint to retrieve a list of all applications. Supports pagination and filtering.
  • Webhooks: Added support for real-time event notifications. Users can now register listener URLs to receive automated updates on Application changes and expired Estimations.
1.0.0 initial release
